am.puzzle.make-four.title: Make exactly four
am.puzzle.make-four.brief: Sow one seed so a pit reaches four and is collected.
am.puzzle.make-four.hint.1: A single seed added to three makes a capture.
am.puzzle.beyond-empty.title: Take beyond the empty pit
am.puzzle.beyond-empty.brief: End beside an empty pit and collect the seeds beyond it.
am.puzzle.beyond-empty.hint.1: One seed from pit zero finishes beside the empty second pit.
am.puzzle.long-relay.title: Follow the long relay
am.puzzle.long-relay.brief: Choose the pit whose relay gathers at least twenty-five seeds.
am.puzzle.long-relay.hint.1: Count forward from pit ten and follow every pickup.
am.puzzle.harvest-relay.title: Harvest the relay
am.puzzle.harvest-relay.brief: Find the sowing line that collects forty-two seeds.
am.puzzle.harvest-relay.hint.1: The fourth occupied pit on your row starts the richest chain.
am.puzzle.final-sweep.title: Call the final sweep
am.puzzle.final-sweep.brief: Choose the pit that ends the round with player one ahead.
am.puzzle.final-sweep.hint.1: The two seeds in pit four empty the opponent row at the right moment.
am.puzzle.last-count.title: The last count
am.puzzle.last-count.brief: Only one sowing choice wins the final count for player two.
am.puzzle.last-count.hint.1: The single seed in pit twelve controls the sweep.
am.recap.harvest.large: This sow banked {seeds} seeds across {captures} captures.
am.recap.relay.long: The relay continued through {pickups} handfuls before ending.
am.recap.lead.changed: This harvest turned a deficit into a lead of {lead} seeds.
am.recap.final.sweep: The final sow emptied the next side; the remaining rows were banked and the harvest ended.
am.recap.harvest.exposed: This sow was followed by a rival harvest of {seeds} seeds.
am.achievement.first-match.title: First Sowing
am.achievement.first-match.desc: Complete your first match on the Alaguli Mane board.
am.achievement.first-win.title: A Full Granary
am.achievement.first-win.desc: Win your first match as the local player.
am.achievement.six-puzzles.title: Pattern Keeper
am.achievement.six-puzzles.desc: Solve all six Alaguli Mane puzzles.
am.achievement.first-daily.title: Morning Lamp
am.achievement.steady-rhythm.title: Steady Rhythm
am.achievement.steady-rhythm.desc: Build a best daily rhythm of three days.
am.achievement.generous-harvest.title: Generous Harvest
am.achievement.generous-harvest.desc: Gather at least twelve seeds through captures in one sow.
am.achievement.three-captures.title: Three Baskets
am.achievement.three-captures.desc: Trigger three capture events during one sow.
am.achievement.long-relay.title: The Long Relay
am.achievement.long-relay.desc: Lift and continue from at least three pits during one turn.
am.achievement.turning-tide.title: Turning Tide
am.achievement.turning-tide.desc: Recover the lead during the match and carry it to victory.
am.share.result.win.title: The Granary Overflows
am.share.result.loss.title: The Harvest Is Counted
am.share.result.draw.title: An Even Harvest
am.share.result.draw.body: Both stores held {score} seeds after {moves} moves.
